title: Attributes & Hyperlink
description:
### Attributes Attributes allow other things, such as the core HTML engine or TypeScript/CSS to actually see places in your code. Attributes are key value pairs inside the opening tag of a element. To add a attribute in a element you put `attributename="value"`. ### a The `a` tag creates a hyperlink to another website. It uses the following syntax: ```html Clickable Text To Link Here ``` The href attribute should be assigned the link you want to go to, e.g. ```html
